title: Frog Jump
description: Determine if a frog can cross a river by jumping on stones, where the jump size must be related to the previous jump.
pseudocode:
1: stonesMap = {val: set(jumps) for val in stones}
2: stonesMap[0].add(0)
3: for i in range(len(stones)):
4:   for jump in stonesMap[stones[i]]:
5:     for nextJump in [jump-1, jump, jump+1]:
6:       if nextJump > 0 and stones[i] + nextJump in stonesMap:
7:         stonesMap[stones[i] + nextJump].add(nextJump)

steps.note: Initialize map of stones and possible jump distances to reach each stone.
Starting stone 0 is reached with a jump of 0.
Jump size at stone 0 is 0. Exploring possible next jumps.
Add jump distance 1 to stone 1's set.
Add jump distance 2 to stone 3's set.
